title: User handbook
description: What you can do in every part of Automazing Flow — and whether each capability is ready.

howTo.title: How to read this handbook
howTo.body: Each page lists what you can do, then breaks it down by tab and feature. Status tells you if it works today or still needs setup.
howTo.step1: Pick a page below and expand it.
howTo.step2: Read “What you can do here”, then open the matching tab.
howTo.step3: Use Open page / Open tab to jump straight into the product.

needsGeneric: Needs: matching connection, API key or MCP provider.
languageNote: Capability text is in English for consistency. App chrome is Swedish/English.
statusNote: Ready = works end-to-end. Needs setup = works after OAuth/keys/MCP. Under development = incomplete.

statusHint.ready: Works end-to-end for the core job.
statusHint.beta: Works after you connect the right accounts or keys.
statusHint.wip: Visible in the app but not fully wired yet.

searchPlaceholder: Search what you can do… (e.g. publish, ROAS, inbox)
empty: No matches — try another word or clear the status filter.
